say:1:1841110001:0.text: You youngsters are forever making trouble for me!
say:1:1841110001:0.source_cn: 你们这些丫头小子，净会给老身惹麻烦！

say:2:1841110002:0.text: I warned you again and again before we left town—tell no one. And what did you do? Turned around and left a note!
say:2:1841110002:0.source_cn: 出城前老身千叮咛万嘱咐，不可告诉别人，你可倒好，转头便...

say:3:1841110003:0.female: Baba, if I hadn't left it, Estrilda and <style="stress"><player_name></style> would've been in danger.

say:4:1841110004:0.text: Hmph. You and that bleeding heart of yours! Always trying to save everyone!
say:4:1841110004:0.source_cn: 哼，就你心软，就你是滥好人！
